title: Oscars: 38 Animated Movies, 104 International Films and 190 Documentaries Make the Eligibility Lists, Setting New Records
summary: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has released the lists of films eligible for animated feature, documentary feature and international feature at the 99th Academy Awards, and two of the three are setting records.
